slides.text:
Dinner early enough
to stop thinking about it

Protein, carbs, done

Legs up,
lights down

Boring is the point

Same time
as last night

The streak is the whole trick

slides.heading: Sleep is the session you never skip
slides.body: SOMA reads last night from your watch and turns it into tomorrow's plan — so a good night actually pays off
